task: This is a synthetic writing exercise. Using these fictional reporting notes, write a newspaper news story for general readers. Draw only on the supplied notes; do not invent additional reported events, scenes, or quotations. Write from this reporting snapshot as of February 19, 2025. Include a headline. Target 450 to 650 words. Follow AP style.

facts.text: Caldwell Motors announced on February 19, 2025, a voluntary recall of 94,000 Caldwell Apex electric vehicles from model years 2022 through 2024.
The recall follows seven thermal runaway incidents and two vehicle fires reported over a 14-month period.
No fatalities have been reported; three injuries resulted from the incidents, all minor.
Caldwell and battery supplier NovaChem Battery Solutions identified the root cause as a manufacturing defect in anode coating applied at NovaChem's Plant 4 facility.
The defect reduces the anode's resistance to lithium plating under rapid charging conditions, increasing thermal runaway risk.
Plant 4 produced battery modules for Apex vehicles assembled between January 2022 and August 2024.
Caldwell CEO Miriam Foster said: "We identified this issue through our own field data monitoring and brought it to regulators before any agency contacted us. Customer safety is not negotiable."

The National Vehicle Safety Board chair, Raymond Dahl, confirmed the agency had received Caldwell's preliminary findings three weeks before the public announcement and was conducting its own parallel investigation.
Owners will be notified by mail and can schedule a free battery module inspection at any authorized Caldwell dealer.
Affected vehicles will have a software-enforced charging limit of 80% of capacity until the physical inspection is completed.
If an inspection finds a defective module, Caldwell will replace the entire battery pack at no cost; replacement is expected to take approximately four hours.
NovaChem has halted production at Plant 4 pending a full quality audit; the company declined to comment on the financial impact.
Caldwell's stock fell 7.4% in morning trading on the day of the announcement.
Thermal runaway occurs when a single battery cell overheats and triggers a chain reaction in neighboring cells, releasing energy that can lead to fire.
The Apex accounts for approximately 18% of Caldwell's global vehicle sales.

Consumer safety attorney Diana Reyes, not affiliated with any pending lawsuit, said the self-initiated recall and proactive software limit would likely influence how regulators assess the company's conduct.
Six of the seven thermal incidents occurred during or immediately after high-speed DC fast charging.
The 80% charge limit reduces peak battery stress but also reduces the vehicle's maximum driving range by roughly 20% until the module is inspected.
Caldwell sold approximately 31,000 Apex vehicles in 2022, 38,000 in 2023, and 25,000 in the first eight months of 2024 before the model was updated.
The recall affects only Apex vehicles with battery serial numbers in a specific range that Caldwell says it can identify from its production database.
